freeze_semantics: Content-hash freeze of the opencode adapter's output over the conformance-scenario corpus at harness 1.17.15 (opencode carries its release version in-band on session.version; this is a post-1.14.40 schema shape). verify.py re-runs preprocess+DSL on each input (cwd = this dir, input paths relative) and asserts trace_count, per-trace content_hash, and unmapped_path_count. content_hash folds provenance.source_path, so inputs MUST stay at inputs/<name>.db. annotated_cells_fired is the structural fired-cell set (drift self-test asserts it equals the opencode CELL_SIGNALS extractor exactly). Newer end of opencode's IMAGE release delta 1.2.20 -> 1.17.15 (both version-pinned container captures via frameworks/opencode/). The scoped db carries the six trace-relevant tables opencode 1.17.15 wrote for this session (session/message/part/session_message/event/event_sequence); auth/infra plumbing tables (credential/account, empty) are dropped. Note vs 1.2.20: 1.17.15 populates the `event` table and its part/message data carry additional fields (unmapped_path_count 40 -> 60); cells are unchanged, so the adapter still maps the same contract surface (the new unmapped event-table surface is the OC-0001 ledger entry).
capture_provenance: Live version-pinned CONTAINER capture on the arm64 capture workstation, 2026-07-23 (REPLACES the earlier host --session-dir capture, per the image-regime backfill). opencode 1.17.15 headless (opencode run --agent build) via the frameworks/opencode/ image (miniobserve/opencode-capture:1.17.15, npm opencode-ai@1.17.15 pinned by OPENCODE_VERSION build-arg), routed straight to the arm64 capture workstation's ollama (qwen2.5:7b, structured tool calls) via the config-configurable provider baseUrl -> host.docker.internal:11434 (no socat needed, unlike pi). cwd is the container /workspace (no host-path PII). Same read-config/write-version s1-config task (basename s1-config.db). The native SQLite store was WAL-checkpointed then scoped to the trace-relevant tables (credential/account empty, dropped). Host brew opencode untouched. Model: ollama/qwen2.5:7b (matches the 1.2.20 baseline, so the harness release is the only variable across the delta). Provenance footnote: the SUPERSEDED host --session-dir capture of 1.17.15 ran ollama/qwen3:8b, not qwen2.5:7b, so a host-rung-vs-image comparison of this version varies BOTH containerization and model (host unmapped_path_count 43 -> 62 across its delta vs this image 40 -> 60); the IMAGE delta 1.2.20 -> 1.17.15 is unaffected because both its ends are qwen2.5:7b.
capture_provenance_round2: Round-2 coverage capture on the arm64 capture workstation (2026-07-25) closing opencode's EXECUTE (cell 8) gap. Same PUBLISHED image, unmodified (miniobserve/opencode-capture:1.17.15 = capture/opencode:1.17.15), same ollama route. FOUR deviations from the s1-config capture, all required and none of them freeze surface: (1) MODEL qwen3:8b, NOT the s1 rung's qwen2.5:7b — three qwen2.5:7b attempts never produced a shell tool call: attempt 1 (archived-arm prompt) called the native Grep tool with a malformed pattern '/TODO/' (0 matches); attempt 2 (nudged prompt) emitted two schema-invalid tool calls (grep missing 'pattern', bash missing 'command'), then Grep '// TODO' (0 matches); attempt 3 called Grep with include='*.js,*.ts,*.jsx,*.tsx', filtering out main.py (0 matches against a seed holding 6 TODOs — a model arg error, NOT an opencode tool bug: grep -rn TODO in the same container finds all 6). qwen3:8b produced a clean single-pass run. (2) PROMPT carries TWO added EXECUTE-steering clauses vs the archived 2026-03-15 first-run S2 arm, both disclosed: 'by running a shell command (grep -rn or rg -n) in the terminal' and 'and show the command you ran and its output'; 'Write' becomes 'Then write'. The frozen prompt is BYTE-IDENTICAL to droid's frozen s2-todo-grep prompt, so the scenario arm is shared across the two harnesses. Necessary because opencode's native Grep tool otherwise satisfies the task with no EXECUTE, and EXECUTE coverage is the scenario's whole purpose. (3) PERMISSION override via OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT (a final local-scope config merge; the image and its entrypoint-written opencode.json are untouched): {'permission':{'bash':'allow','external_directory':{'*':'allow'}}}. Without it opencode auto-rejects the arm's /tmp/claude/todos.txt target in headless mode ('permission requested: external_directory (/tmp/claude/*); auto-rejecting'), so the arm cannot complete. This is opencode's analogue of droid's --auto high. (4) HOME and XDG_{DATA,CONFIG}_HOME on a SEPARATE /ochome mount, not the frameworks/opencode README's documented HOME=/workspace — under HOME=/workspace opencode writes .npm/.cache/.local INTO the tree the s2 search walks, so an rg sweep would hit provider node_modules. Same reasoning as droid putting DROID_HOME off /workspace. Scenario seed is byte-identical to droid's round-2 s2 seed, i.e. the archived S2 arm workspace minus that arm's .gitignore (immaterial here: it ignores only __pycache__/*.pyc/tasks.json/.venv, none present, none carrying TODOs); the current shell-pipeline/containers/shared/workspace seed was NOT used because its main.py has TODO renamed to IMPROVE, which would make the S2 prompt match nothing. Off-target attempt state retained under captures/opencode-1.17.15-round2/ (attempt1-greptool, attempt2-permdenied, attempt3-jsincludefilter), not frozen.
